Kaaviokuva kolmessa osassa, ei mittakaav: Diagram in three parts, not to scale. On the left is a rectangular box, the solid. Then comes a minus sign and an upright cylinder drawn grey with a dashed line: it is the hole, a solid that is removed. The cylinder is taller than the box so that the hole surely goes through. After the equals sign on the right is the same box with a round hole through its top face: the hole has been grouped with the solid into one model.
Cross-section seen from the side, not to scale. A horizontal table top of thickness t comes from the left. Around the right edge of the table top is a U-shaped holder: its upper arm is on top of the board, its upright part behind the edge of the board and its lower arm under the board. The gap between the holder's arms is a, slightly larger than the board's thickness t. The gap left between the arms and the board is the clearance. In the figure the gap is drawn much larger than it really is, so that it can be seen.
Kaaviokuva ylhäältä, ei mittakaavassa: p: Diagram from above, not to scale: a long narrow test piece with four round holes in a row. From left to right the holes' diameters are 10.0 mm, 10.2 mm, 10.4 mm and 10.6 mm, and the differences are drawn larger than they really are. Each hole's diameter is written under it. A 10 millimetre peg is tried in the holes to see which hole is suitably loose.
